title: Chapter 2736: Liu Yucang
content:
Chapter 2736: Liu Yucang

"What? You don’t like that one either? Then how about Moss Head? Moldy Bun Head?" Yuan kept throwing one ridiculous nickname after another at Liu Yucang, leaving not only him stunned, but Xu Jiaqi and the others too.

Even Qiang Qing Yun only dared to call him Broccoli Head once in a while because she knew just how badly Liu Yucang handled his temper.

Xu Jiaqi and Qiang Qing Yun immediately prepared to fight Liu Yucang to protect Yuan.

However, Liu Yucang stood as still as a stone statue, his head lowered and his face hidden beneath his long, green hair.

Liu Yucang had been ready to explode with anger when Yuan first called him Bush Head. Yet the more Yuan mocked him, the calmer he became.

’Calling me Bush Head and Moss Head is one thing... but Moldy Bun Head? That’s too specific!’ Liu Yucang cried inwardly as his childhood memories resurfaced.

Yuan continued speaking a moment later, but he was no longer mocking Liu Yucang with nicknames.

"Jade Tiger Mountain Valley," Yuan said, naming a location that instantly sent jolts through Liu Yucang’s entire being.

Liu Yucang slowly lifted his head to stare at Yuan with trembling eyes.

"If I remember correctly, there were seven of you at that time," said Yuan.

"Y-You... You can’t be..." Liu Yucang muttered in a daze.

Yuan replied with a smile, "I’ll explain it to you in a moment. For now, just calm down."

"..."

After a moment of silence, Liu Yucang nodded quietly, then completely retracted his aura.

This left everyone speechless, as no one had ever seen Liu Yucang act so obediently before.

’What the hell is going on?’ Bi Ao cried inwardly, unable to comprehend the situation.

Meanwhile, Xu Jiaqi and Qiang Qing Yun had an idea of why Liu Yucang suddenly calmed down.

Shortly after, Yuan turned to Bi Ao and asked, "Do you have anything else to say?"

"No, not really... There’s nothing I can really do at this point but wait for the outcome," Bi Ao responded with a casual shrug before turning around and vanishing into thin air.

Those who’d followed him to the headquarters also left.

Eventually, only Yuan and the other three Celestial Overlords—and their followers—remained.

"Let’s go somewhere more private, shall we?" Yuan said.

Some time later, they entered a private chamber used only by the Celestial Overlords.

Once the doors closed, Yuan turned to Liu Yucang and said, "First and foremost, let me catch you up to speed."

"Yes, I am who you think I am—but also not at the same time."

"What is that supposed to mean?" Liu Yucang asked, raising an eyebrow.

"The man who found you in Jade Tiger Mountain Valley when you were a dirty bandit is dead, and I am his reincarnation," Yuan gave a brief explanation.

Liu Yucang’s jaw dropped.

"His... reincarnation?"

"It’s true," Qiang Qing Yun confirmed.

Liu Yucang looked at her with raised eyebrows.

"And what is your relationship with him?" he asked.

"That’s none of your business."

Liu Yucang didn’t get upset at her refusal to answer and turned to Xu Jiaqi.

"What about her? Is she really your adoptive daughter?" he asked Yuan.

"Technically, I never formally adopted her as my daughter," Yuan admitted.

"Oh? So you’ve been lying this entire time?" Liu Yucang looked at Xu Jiaqi and chuckled provocatively.

Before Xu Jiaqi could even respond, Yuan continued, "With that being said, she was definitely like a daughter to me—to Tian Yingzhe."

"Yuan... You..." Xu Jiaqi’s eyes flickered with emotions.

Yuan turned to Xu Jiaqi with an apologetic smile.

"Sorry for keeping it a secret from you this entire time, but I have known about being Tian Yingzhe’s reincarnation long before our talk about Fateful Reincarnations. I had contemplated telling you back then, but I wasn’t sure how to reveal it to you, so it just kept on dragging."

After a moment of silence, Xu Jiaqi asked in a low voice, "How much do you remember?"

"Not everything, but I do remember all of our time together."

"I see... so you remember everything..."

Xu Jiaqi tried to stay calm and hold back her tears, but in the end she couldn’t, and a single tear slipped from the corner of her eye.

"There’s no need to hold yourself back."

Yuan suddenly approached her, arms spread.

The moment Xu Jiaqi saw the look on Yuan’s face, whatever restraint she had left completely shattered. She rushed into his embrace and buried her face against his chest, bawling her eyes out.

"You vanished without a word, leaving no trace behind! Even hundreds of thousands of years later, I never stopped searching for you! I spread my name throughout the Nine Heavens, hoping that one day it would reach you and bring you back to me! I’ve missed you so much!" she cried.

"I’m sorry for disappearing on you... on everyone without a word..." Yuan mumbled as he caressed the back of her head like Tian Yingzhe used to.

Qiang Qing Yun and Liu Yucang stared at them with their eyes wide open in disbelief. Not even in their wildest dreams had they imagined they would ever see Xu Jiaqi cry like this, much less utter such passionate words.

After crying for several long minutes, Xu Jiaqi eventually managed to calm down.

When she finally lifted her face from Yuan’s chest, her eyes and nose were still bright red, while the front of his robes was soaked with her tears and snot.

"Now then, let’s talk about the future of the faction," Yuan said, then turned to Liu Yucang.

"But before that... why are you trying to become the leader?"

"Honestly, I had no intention of doing so when I first joined the faction. I was never the leader type, after all. However..." Liu Yucang looked at Xu Jiaqi before continuing, "When I saw this woman claiming to be your daughter, I thought she was lying and using your name to her advantage. Not only that, but the faction had already split into two sides by the time I joined. When I saw the state it was in, I had no choice but to step forward and join the power struggle, hoping to win everything. I couldn’t bear to watch your legacy be tarnished."
